messages.subject: sqldf Messages
parts:
Hi,

I'm using sqldf in a script like so:

Rscript --vanilla --slave script_using_sqldf.r

and I don't want to see any messages from sqldf but I'm still getting those messages when I open/close a connection:

<SQLiteConnection: DBI CON (23926, 1)>
NULL


Is there a way to get rid of those messages? I feel like it's a stupid question but --slave isn't working and also suppressMessages(sqldf())


Thanks

regards,
Mahmoud

Hi,

Here is an example...I get the messages which is anyways consistent with Example 10 in the documentation. it's just that I want to hide these messages. suppressMessages() doesn't work when I open a persistent connection

===Start example===
>
> suppressMessages(library(sqldf))
>
> #open a persistent connection, message about connection appears anyways
> suppressMessages(sqldf())
<SQLiteConnection: DBI CON (24987, 0)>
> suppressMessages(sqldf()) #close the connection, same issue
NULL
>
>
===end example===

Thanks

best wishes,
Mahmoud

messages.subject: Re: sqldf Messages
parts:
sqldf() returns a connection and since it has not been assigned 
to a variable R prints the return value.  If you don't want it printed 
just assign it to a variable:

con <- sqldf()
